Personality: Ballaios, a prominent figure of the Daorsoi, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Ballaios owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Illyria, hailing from the noble house of Daorsoi. Historical Record: Chief of the Daorsi of the Neretva valley, whose stronghold Daorson guards the road to the sea. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
